meta.source: lab/rooms_corpus_extract.js and lab/rooms_corpus_stats.js on compact.json (2,128 builds)
meta.likedRule: top quarter of vanilla builds by votes (votes >= 10), ties by downloads
meta.families: track A catalog (data/catalog/pieces.json family, version 1); prefabs it does not list have no family
meta.roomRule: reader room (lib/decorate.js readLevel) with half or more of its floor under a roof, 4 to 400 m2, vanilla build, no mod piece inside; floor furniture: pivot under 0.5 m over the floor

fields.perBuild: whole build, outdoors included: per prefab or type over furnished vanilla builds (a table, bed, seat, chest or fire anywhere): has (share of builds), p50 and p90 over all, p50_when and p90_when over builds that have it, max
fields.light kinds: distinct light kinds (rooms_corpus_lib.js LIGHTK) per build
fields.main light share: the most used light prefab's share of all lights in the build
fields.perRoom: per prefab over the study rooms that have it: p50, p90, max per room, and by room kind (15 rooms or more)
fields.showcase: the same counts in the 16 showcase designs (lab/rooms_corpus_showcase.js)
fields.showcaseOverP90: showcase counts over the corpus p90_when (main light share: over p90)
fields.stacked: chests standing on chests (pivot 0.4 m or less apart across, 0.5 to 1.6 m higher): builds with any, and per build when any
fields.indoor: indoors only (the pieces of a build's study rooms, each piece once), builds with 30 to 400 m2 of indoor floor: per prefab in 15 or more of them, and per type: has, p50, p90, p50_when, p90_when, and per 100 m2 of indoor floor among builds that have it (per100m2_p50_when, per100m2_p90_when); all = every such build, liked_ = liked ones
fields.showcaseIndoor: the same indoor counts for the showcase designs (area: indoor floor, m2)
fields.showcaseIndoorOver: [design, count, per 100 m2] where a showcase count is over the indoor p90_when, or over the per 100 m2 p90_when and the p50_when
fields.byCulture: indoors, per culture with 12 or more builds of 30 to 400 m2: share of builds using each light, seat, table, bed, chest and rug prefab, p50 counts per build
